name: Natesan Park
surface: Paved walkway; sand under the equipment area
shade: Partial — tree cover over half the stations
water: Public tap near the north gate
timings: Early morning and evening walking hours

notes: Starter entry, not a verified inventory. Walk the park and correct the list before sharing it with anyone.
